mentions.name: Opinionated Identity Provider (next-gen Keycloak alternative)
mentions.description: An opinionated identity provider designed with security and performance as first-class priorities, positioned as a next-generation take on Keycloak. It aims to deliver a holistic product built in one go, rather than the incremental evolution that dilutes security, performance, and architecture in existing identity products.
mentions.problem: Existing identity products dilute security, performance, and architecture aspects because they are built incrementally with VC funding and a fragmented understanding of the identity space.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on an opinionated identity provider from security and performance perspective (sort of next version of keycloak).
